verdict.rationale: Stable has its own documented API, but the docs say it 'currently' covers only searching and retrieving MailItems and creating and onboarding Locations, plus some Company and Check objects. Many UI actions show no API equivalent: shipping, check deposit, shredding, tagging, routing, team assignment, and roles/permissions. Webhook endpoints and API keys are configured only through the dashboard, so the API falls well short of UI parity. Missing for 10: API coverage of mail actions (scan, forward, deposit, shred), tags, routing rules, users/roles, webhook and API-key management via API, and a published OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404).
